# Collectron: Nuka Cola

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 7, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cbe1bfc169d1459cac26d88a3fed8d98~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Collectron: Nuka Cola__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_5e103142ca69422986d755aebaee1f51~mv2.png)

*Having a bad day? Have a Nuka-Cola! Don’t have any Nuka-Cola? Let this Collectron find some for you!*

## **__Overview__**

__Overview__

The Nuka-Cola Collectron Station sends out a themed robot to gather various Nuka-Cola beverages from across Appalachia.

## **__Function__**

__Function__

Use the Perk Card "Cola Nut" to buff the base effects by 2x (Rank 1) or 3x (Rank 2).

| **Item Produced** | **Buff Type** | **Base Effect** | **Drop Rate** | 
| Nuka-Cola | AP Refill | +10 AP | 19.84% | 
| Nuka-Cola Cherry | AP Refill | +25 AP | 14.54% | 
| Nuka-Cola Orange | AP Refill | +10 AP | 14.54% | 
| Nuka-Cola Wild | AP Refill | +25 AP | 13.08% | 
| Nuka-Grape | AP Refill + Rad Removal | +50 AP / -400 Rads | 12.83% | 
| Nuka-Cola Cranberry | XP Buff | +2% XP for 30 minutes | 9.50% | 
| Nuka-Cola Bottle (Empty) | Junk | | 10.68% | 
| Nuka-Cola Quantum | AP Refill | +100 AP | 5.00% | 

- Production Rate: 1 item every 7 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: No
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Shares Build Limit With: All other Collectron Stations
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 7

__Crafting Requirements__

- 1x Circuitry
- 1x Copper
- 1x Gear
- 3x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 10 pounds

__How to Unlock__

- Season Reward: 
 - Season 4 – Armor Ace and the Power Patrol in Cold Steel
- Gold Bullion Vendor: 
 - Samuel – 1250 Gold Bullion
 - Requires Cautious reputation with Settlers
- Tradeable: No
- Giftable: No

Related Links:

__Build Restrictions__

- Cannot be built inside Shelters
- Only available while in CAMP Mode
